issues.detail: Rule quote is a single waveform line; no verbatim evidence that hold applies to all a=1 posedges (S05-S13).
Rule quote is a single waveform line; no verbatim evidence that increment applies to all a=0 posedges (S15-S21).
Example expected q sequence 5,6,0 implies wrap at 3 bits, but spec waveform shows 4->5->6->0 only after a=0; no explicit wrap evidence for 7->0.
Spec waveform shows q=4 at first posedge with a=1, but contract has no reset/initial value; alternative semantics: q initializes to 4 at time 0.
issues.alternative: q initializes to 4 at time 0 (no reset), then holds/increments per rules.

issues.detail: Spec waveform shows q=4 at 5ns with a=1, but contract has no reset; alternative: q initializes to 0 and first posedge with a=1 loads 4.
issues.alternative: q initializes to 0; first posedge with a=1 sets q=4 (load), then holds/increments per rules.

issues.detail: Contract rules cannot reproduce spec waveform: at 5ns a=1 posedge q should be 4, but no initial value/reset is defined; derived outputs from rules alone are undefined at first posedge.
Spec waveform at 45ns posedge a=0 q stays 4 (S13), but increment_when_a_low would increment to 5; contradiction between rule and waveform.
Spec waveform at 55ns posedge a=0 q becomes 5 (S15), consistent with increment; but at 45ns a=0 q stayed 4, so increment condition is not simply a==0.
Rule increment_when_a_low says increment on every posedge with a=0, but spec waveform S13 (45ns, a=0) holds q=4; rule contradicts spec example.
Spec waveform shows q=4 at 5ns with a=1, but no reset; alternative: q is initialized to 4 via an implicit load when a=1 at first posedge.
issues.alternative: At first posedge with a=1, q loads 4; thereafter hold when a=1 and increment when a=0.
